subject: QMAN_COMPONENT

sut.environment: WSL2 Ubuntu 22.04 native ext4 state, Python 3.10.12, real subprocess/os._exit/SIGKILL faults, and retained checkpoint copies on DrvFS

hypotheses: A host-local Static lease component must atomically persist VM generation, complete-bundle claims, member claims, transaction state and journal before any external side effect.
A process death before SQLite commit must leave no partial begin or release state, while an uncertain post-prepare or post-attach outcome must retain the complete bundle claim and quarantine it.
Authority, host, bundle and device-generation namespaces must be durable CAS inputs so concurrent or stale requests cannot splice facts or double-allocate an overlapping member.

result.S03: simulated bind-failure label plus test-only cleanup assertion atomically advanced both generations and released claims
result.S04: simulated reset-verification failure quarantined the complete bundle and retained claims
result.S05: missing cleanup evidence after a simulated QEMU-start label quarantined the complete bundle and retained claims
result.F00: a real SIGKILL of an ATTACHED Python owner left durable state; UNSAFE_OR_UNKNOWN reconcile quarantined the bundle and retained claims

limitations: This is a standalone persistence/CAS/FSM component, not a production Static controller or end-to-end launch path. S03, S04, S05 and F00 remain IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED.
Bind, reset, VFIO, QEMU start and cleanup-verification phases are simulated labels. The S03 cleanup_verified input is a trusted test assertion, not independently authenticated device-clean evidence.
The F00 SIGKILL target is a Python owner process, not QEMU. No pidfd identity, VFIO ownership, DMA/IRQ teardown, reset, driver restoration or physical-device clean state was proved.
The fixed lab authority traverses the schema-v4 trusted_authority_id and store_instance_id gates, but the experiment does not prove the G1 authoritative inventory publisher or trust root.

SQLite WAL/FULL on an allowlisted local filesystem proves this component's transaction behavior; it does not prove end-to-end power-loss durability, storage-controller flush semantics or multi-host fencing.
No product Case, Risk, milestone, HCL entry or support claim is closed by this result.
